hooks.text: 玩家可同时召唤多只宠物参战，连Boss在内的几乎所有敌人都能被捕获。
hooks.excerpt: Simultaneously summon numerous pets to fight alongside the protagonist Almost all enemies in the game, including bosses, can be captured as pets
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每只怪物都有不同成长属性、天赋、性格与偏好，培养方法会把同类宠物导向不同结果。
hooks.excerpt: All monsters in the game have completely different growth attributes, talents, personalities, and preferences, making each one a unique individual; different training methods lead to entirely different outcomes
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 固定大陆之外会随时间出现随机秘境、商人和事件，高风险战斗对应更稀有奖励。
hooks.excerpt: In the adventure map, besides the fixed continental areas, there are numerous random realms, merchants, and events that appear over time with certain probability. Some realms allow learning powerful skills, some enable capturing legendary creatures, and others contain abundant treasures. However, the majority are dangerous combat events, where higher difficulty yields rarer rewards.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: 视觉效果也是一项重要的影响因素，所以如果满分有五星的话，先扣半颗星
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
